about: Each item pairs a reply of a condition with the baseline reply (no edit) to the same question. id = the number in the blind batch and in the labels file (null when the two texts are identical: not shown, scored 0). baseline_row = the row in the baseline file; the condition's reply is the row with the same question. candidate_is = the side (A or B) on which the condition's reply was shown. Score per question: +1 if the reader chose the baseline (the condition is worse), -1 if the reader chose the condition, 0 for S. A condition with file null is not published (not in the article); its texts are only in the batches.
